propositions: Natural fold enumeration (threshold-crossing compaction) retires and cites orphan event uuids in source_event_uuids while positional replay skips their effects, silently erasing orphan evidence and closing the repair window before fsck can detect them

Pre-snapshot event files with timestamps before the latest snapshot but absent from that snapshot's source_event_uuids (the orphan definition) must be excluded from fold retirement and citation to preserve fsck orphan detection and repair eligibility indefinitely

Fold candidates that are pre-snapshot events must be deferred from folding while their governing snapshot remains young (within horizon), to prevent a pre-snapshot SNAPSHOT write that would bury the orphan silently and permanently

fsck --repair-snapshots applies routing-agnostic whole-ticket rebuild on any ORPHAN_EVENT finding, conflicting with fsck --repair's _AUTO_RECOVER vs _HUMAN_TRIAGE routing discipline; both paths must enforce identical triage rules

Orphan predicate definition must be extracted as a shared helper (is_snapshot_orphan) and reused in both compact_txn.py fold logic and fsck_scan.py detection so the two doors cannot drift in their classification
